Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: In the second step, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the initial DuckDuckGo search results. Specifically, it noted that the "IMDb results shown indicate a birthplace of Nara, Japan, which contradicts common authoritative bios." This was a hallucination or a misreading of the provided text. The visible text in the first step clearly showed biographypot.com and bijog.com stating "Naha, Okinawa," and while an IMDb snippet was visible in the metadata, the Planner falsely claimed it showed "Nara" as a contradiction, leading to unnecessary confusion and a failed attempt to verify against Britannica despite already having sufficient evidence from the Wikipedia page in the same turn. The error was in the analysis/interpretation of the data rather than a factual error about the song or artist, but it led to an inefficient and erroneous path in the reasoning process.
